id: title:Gilbert09:give a clear error when tiktok ads oauth grants no ad account

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the error response and HTTP status for TikTok OAuth setup when no ad accounts are authorized, potentially changing the user-facing message and status code.
review.reason: Adds a conditional check for TikTok OAuth responses where advertiser_ids is an empty list, raising a ValidationError with a specific message instead of the generic exception. This could change the HTTP status and user-facing message for TikTok OAuth setup failures.
